messages:
micah_sales: Handing off CirrusBio (cirrusbio.com) to CS. Enterprise clinical analytics customer. Contract signed 2026-05-01 for 1 year. Primary asks: HIPAA compliance posture, US-only data residency, single-tenant private deployment (on-prem eval later), low-latency real-time inference for triage use case. Renewal note: early renewal conversation expected at month 9. :handshake:
anya_csm: Thanks Micah  I'll run onboarding and own day-to-day. Quick clarifying Qs: do they need HIPAA BAA checklist before kickoff? Who is their infra lead?
micah_sales: Yes BAA required (legal confirmed). Infra lead: Tom King (tom.king@cirrusbio.com). Procurement will want a monthly invoice cadence. Health: amber because they need HIPAA and a narrow go-live window. Risk: SOC2 is fine but BAA + legal review may take 10 business days.
ida_enablement: I'll prepare admin + API usage training. Recommend two sessions: 45m admin + 45m dev deep-dive. Prefer running dev session after infra is provisioned.
jorge_sre: Heads up from infra: private deploy (US-east GCP) needs VPC peering + customer-managed KMS for keys. Need project ID, list of CIDR ranges, and expected storage/profile for KV cache. Also need target p99 latency SLO and qps numbers.
nell_support: Support note: they asked for priority response during pilot hours (M-F 08:00-20:00 ET) and escalation path to eng for infra faults. We'll set on-call rotation accordingly.
micah_sales: Expected workload: embed+search + convo API. Models: 13B for batch reranking, 2B for realtime triage. qps: realtime ~20 qps sustained per instance, bursts to 60 qps. Vector storage expected ~200M vectors.
anya_csm: Quick handoff checklist I'm putting in CS ticket CS-6001:
```
- Contract: signed + BAA required
- Kickoff: schedule by 2026-04-20
- INF ticket: INF-8842 (private deploy + KMS whitelist + KV sizing)
- SSO ticket: SSO-331 (Okta + SCIM provisioning)
- Enablement: admin (45m) + dev (45m) sessions
- Support: pilot hours on-call + escalation path
- Owner: @anya_csm; SRE owner: @jorge_sre; Support: @nell_support; Enablement: @ida_enablement
```
micah_sales: I'll intro Tom and their security lead (liaison:@security-team) on the thread and attach the preflight checklist link: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/cirrusbio-internal
deploy-bot: Deployment stub created: INF-8842 linked to CS-6001
jorge_sre: INF-8842 created 64 description: "CirrusBio private deploy US-east GCP: VPC peering, KMS integration, dedicated pool sizing (13B batch + 2B realtime), vector storage ~200M vectors)." Link: https://redwood.example.com/tickets/INF-8842
ell_support: I'll open SUPPORT-1122 for pilot on-call schedule and runbook. Will need runbook inputs from SRE and CSM (playbooks, test steps, rollback plan).
ida_enablement: Proposed dates week-of-2026-04-26. I'll send a doodle to Tom and Micah to confirm.
anya_csm: Action owners & deadlines:
- @jorge_sre: infra spec + estimate (INF-8842)  due 2026-04-16
- @nell_support: pilot runbook + on-call schedule (SUPPORT-1122)  due 2026-04-18
- @ida_enablement: training materials + invites  due 2026-04-20
- @micah_sales: intro to Tom + procurement invoice cadence  ongoing
Please add any blockers now. Also flagging renewal touchpoint at month 9 to sales. :calendar:
micah_sales: No immediate blockers. I'll chase Tom for project ID and CIDR. Thanks everyone for moving fast. :rocket:
